title: CourtLens refactor branch-base contract (Phase 0)
description: Frozen record of which product commits the CourtLens refactor branch will inherit and which will be excluded. Consumed by future PR 1 (refactor/courtlens-from-legacy) as the authoritative starting point.

baseline.rationale: Planning branch is cut from main and contains zero product commits. The refactor branch will branch from this same SHA so nothing on proof/courtlens-gap3-final leaks in automatically.

excludedEvidenceOnlyCommits.subject: feat(gap3): finalize CourtLens Gap 3 evidence with canonical audit-integrity proof
excludedEvidenceOnlyCommits.reason: Adds only artifacts/courtlens-gap3-final/**, reports/gap3/**, and apps/abr/scripts/gap3/audit-integrity-proof.ts. No product code. Refactor branch does not inherit or reuse Gap 3 evidence.

excludedEvidenceOnlyCommits.subject: chore(courtlens/gap3): seal v2 audit-chain evidence + manifest
excludedEvidenceOnlyCommits.reason: Adds only artifacts/courtlens-gap3-final-v2/**, reports/gap3-v2/**, docs/gap3/canonical-audit-hash-v1.md, and apps/abr/scripts/gap3-v2/production-hash-vectors.ts. No product code.

excludedEvidenceOnlyCommits.subject: docs(courtlens/gap3): 21-item closure report v2 (IMPLEMENTED_NOT_PROVEN)
excludedEvidenceOnlyCommits.reason: Single-file docs report. No product code, no schema, no tests.

mixedCommitsRequiringCherryPickReview.subject: feat(abr): close CourtLens Gap 3 implementation and proof tooling
mixedCommitsRequiringCherryPickReview.cherryPickRationale: Phase 1 will re-establish the review-packet route in a separate, later PR after Phase 1 UI ships. The refactor branch stays focused on read-only badges + panels; taking review-packet along would blur the Phase 1 boundary and inherit the Gap 3 audit conventions that Phase 0 has not yet ratified.

mixedCommitsRequiringCherryPickReview.subject: fix(abr): harden CourtLens review-packet audit persistence and proof coverage
mixedCommitsRequiringCherryPickReview.cherryPickRationale: Audit-persistence changes here are entangled with the Gap 3 review-packet route. Phase 1 does not add any new audit-writing surfaces; the current on-main audit-log.ts is sufficient. If Phase 1 needs any of these changes it must arrive via a separate reviewed PR, not by inheritance.

mixedCommitsRequiringCherryPickReview.subject: fix(abr): separate vitest/playwright runners and stabilize audit org resolution
mixedCommitsRequiringCherryPickReview.cherryPickRationale: The vitest/playwright runner split is genuinely useful; Phase 1 needs SOME Playwright setup. However, importing it as a cherry-pick means importing the associated audit-log changes too. Recommend: re-derive the vitest/playwright split from scratch in the refactor branch rather than cherry-pick.

mixedCommitsRequiringCherryPickReview.subject: fix(abr,audit): persist canonical hash timestamp + version for independent recomputation (CourtLens Gap 3)
mixedCommitsRequiringCherryPickReview.cherryPickRationale: Adds columns and hashing convention driven by Gap 3 requirements. Phase 1 does not add or change any audit event; DB migration 0032 belongs to the review-packet track, not to Phase 1.

mixedCommitsRequiringCherryPickReview.subject: fix(union-eyes,sage-core): repair pre-existing test failures uncovered during Gap 3 workspace validation
mixedCommitsRequiringCherryPickReview.cherryPickRationale: This commit legitimately fixes pre-existing test flakiness in union-eyes and sage-core. It is orthogonal to CourtLens Phase 1. Recommend landing it as a standalone PR against main before the refactor branch opens, so both the proof branch and the refactor branch inherit it cleanly.

mixedCommitsRequiringCherryPickReview.subject: chore(db): regenerate schema snapshot for audit_events.occurred_at + hash_version
mixedCommitsRequiringCherryPickReview.cherryPickRationale: Snapshot corresponds to the 802f7834a migration. Excluded automatically because the migration is excluded.

verificationCommands: for sha in $(git log --format=%H main..proof/courtlens-gap3-final); do git show --stat --format=%s $sha; done

maintainerApproval.notes: This file is Phase 0 output. It becomes the frozen contract for PR 1 only when a maintainer explicitly approves it in the Phase 0 review PR.
